black.comment: Scrims and the iOS firing screen only

borderDefault.comment: Must differ from surfaceCard (darkNeutral.300) so the card hairline is visible

background.comment: Firing screen background — always dark, never follows the app theme

textSecondary.comment: Secondary text on the firing screen (replaces foreground @70%)

controlFill.comment: Snooze tiles / secondary controls on the firing screen

warning.comment: Fill/icon amber — not text-safe on light; use textWarning for text

error.comment: Fill/icon red — use textError for text

onDarkFill.comment: Text/icons on a dark or saturated fill (pick with ChronirBadge.onColor)

onLightFill.comment: Text/icons on a light or bright fill (pick with ChronirBadge.onColor)

light.comment: Switch track when on; the system thumb is always white, so dark mode can't reuse the light primary

firingBackground.comment: iOS ships pure black on the firing screen (OLED)

swipeEdit.comment: Swipe action fill behind the system's white label: 5.17:1 in light and dark

swipeConfirm.comment: Done / Enable swipe action: 5.02:1 with white

Error.comment: Fill red — use MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error / chronirColors.textError for text

Warning.comment: Fill amber — not text-safe on light; use chronirColors.textWarning
